item.title: Iranian institute urges UNICEF to condemn US-Israeli attacks that killed, injured children
item.description: The institute calls for documenting violations, establishing responsibility, and informing affected families of the findings.

item.title: Iran cuts foreign trade decline to 20%, clears border queues despite blockade
item.description: Economy Minister Madanizadeh says structural customs reforms and a shift to overland routes have stabilized trade.

item.title: IRGC announces downing of 58th US MQ-9 drone over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guards Corps announces the destruction of a 58th US military MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz using a newly deployed air defense system.

item.title: Leader’s advisor: Repression of Shia clerics will widen rift between Bahraini regime and people
item.description: A senior advisor to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution says suppression of Shia clerics will widen the gap between the Bahraini regime and people.

item.title: Iran's military capabilities put US in a quandary: Ex-British commander
item.description: Washington’s troop deployments and military build-up raise questions over whether the moves amount to saber-rattling or signal preparations for an attack, while Iran’s retaliatory capabilities and missile power may have factored into US calculations against launching an all-out war.

item.title: Sanders demands end to illegal US-Israeli war on Iran as Senate blocks resolution
item.description: Sanders condemns the US-Israeli war against Iran as based on lies, comparing it to the wars in Vietnam and Iraq and calling for an immediate end to the war.

item.title: Iran calls for emergency OIC meeting as Israel escalates genocide in Gaza
item.description: His call came as a renewed Israeli ground onslaught in the central part of the besieged territory displaced more than 6,000 Palestinians in a single day.

item.title: Italian composer writes requiem for Iran’s martyred Leader
item.description: Italian composer Antonio Pappalardo says he has composed a requiem about Iran’s martyred Leader, which is set to be performed after February.

item.title: Iran rejects unlimited IAEA inspections amid continued military threats
item.description: Najafi said holding Iran responsible for the disruption of the agency’s monitoring activities would amount to reversing cause and effect and blaming the victim rather than the aggressor.

item.title: ‘Unjustifiable crime’: Iran’s military chief vows to avenge Minab schoolchildren’s blood
item.description: Iran’s military chief says the US attack on the school in the city of Minab in February was an unjustifiable crime against children.

item.title: Two violating supertankers explode after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: The IRGC Navy warns of decisive action against vessels attempting to use prohibited routes through the Strait of Hormuz, as two oil-laden supertankers burn following mine explosions.

item.title: Iran denounces IAEA’s double standards over Israel’s non-membership in NPT
item.description: Iran says the IAEA chief is pursuing double standards over his handling of Tehran’s nuclear program and failure to address Israel’s refusal to join the NPT.

item.title: Gaza’s children forced to trade childhood for survival
item.description: Children in Gaza are increasingly forced into child labor and deprived of education and a normal childhood as displacement, poverty and the struggle for survival deepen.

item.title: Protesters stage silent action at UN climate talks, demand action
item.description: Around 50 demonstrators with taped mouths and signs reading “Shame” gathered outside the closing plenary session of the UN climate talks.

item.title: Protesters march in Paris against military spending, demand better education, wages
item.description: Around 150 people, including young people and trade union members, joined Friday’s demonstration as coordinated protests took place across Europe.
